svg.title: Reading the specific-heat nomograph for gases (MSH App. 15): water vapour
svg.text: Reading the specific-heat nomograph for gases (MSH App. 15): water vapour
True specific heats c_p of gases and vapours at 1 atm (Chilton), redrawn from the printed nomograph
Water vapour is gas No. 17 in the table (valid 32–2550 °F). Mark the mean vapour temperature, (124 + 197)/2 ≈ 160 °F,
Find point 17 (water) in the field of numbered points (highlighted).
Lay a straight edge through the temperature mark and point 17 and extend it to the specific-heat scale.
Read c_p ≈ 0.45 Btu/lb·°F (at 124 °F and 197 °F the line gives 0.44–0.45, so the mean value is fine).
Redrawn from the printed nomograph (scales and points digitized); in the exam read the printed chart.
